title: Runtime publication, collector freeze and refresh boundaries
summary:
Сделать compiled snapshot единственным runtime authority, закрыть
late mutation entity collector и закрепить request/job/deploy refresh boundaries.
why:
`@plan/knowledge/research-P11-design.json` §6–§7; D58. `ArrayEntityRegistry::register()` сейчас
доступен после boot, а introspection считает второй revision hash.

exclude:
Octane package dependency or hot reload; fleet-wide atomic cutover; tenant-specific
compiled files; second extension lifecycle FSM; durable stamp consumers.

rules:
One request/job reads one snapshot. Existing `JobProcessing` boundary may
clear memo before the job but never swaps during it. Freeze after compiled entity projection and
morph/audit setup. Late or duplicate registration throws before mutation. Introspection returns
the compiled fingerprint. Activation epoch continues to key live tenant state and never enters it.
guidance:
Preserve `EntityRegistry` read contract; `freeze()` stays implementation-side.
Hydrate from validated scalar snapshot and retain the pinned instance for the unit of work. Document
`octane:reload`/queue restart as deployment obligations without runtime class references.

validation.procedure: duplicate and late register leave collector unchanged
introspection equals authority fingerprint; activation does not change it
job pin, next-job reload, corrupt artifact, activation off fingerprint

deliverables:
Frozen entity projection, authoritative introspection, explicit worker refresh
contract and tests without an Octane dependency.
